# GNK ASG — Computer Session Agenda

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Purpose

When the director is back at the computer, use this agenda to activate only complete and reviewed modules. The session should be operational, not exploratory.

## Before starting

- Open the portal in desktop browser.
- Open the portal on mobile.
- Open the repository.
- Confirm that the public site is stable.
- Confirm that preparation files remain outside public navigation.

## Step 1 — Confirm brand hierarchy

- Main story: GNK ASG.
- Group framework: GNK DINAMO Ltd.
- Personal layer: owner of the group, UBO, director, author or approver where accurate.
- Homepage remains corporate and balanced.

## Step 2 — Confirm first public content package

- Review first article title.
- Review first article text.
- Review image.
- Review metadata.
- Review internal links.
- Review mobile layout.

## Step 3 — Confirm contact and agent setup

- Confirm public contact address.
- Confirm agent sender address.
- Confirm signature.
- Confirm draft-only mode before live operation.
- Confirm calendar availability privacy rule.

## Step 4 — Confirm channels

Priority order:

1. Video channel.
2. Public page.
3. Business network page.

For each channel:

- confirm official account;
- confirm name and visual identity;
- confirm first draft;
- confirm whether first release is manual or controlled.

## Step 5 — Confirm dashboard

Dashboard should show:

- system mode;
- latest content package;
- image status;
- weekly video package;
- contact/agent status;
- public draft status;
- next human action.

## Step 6 — Controlled activation

Activate only if:

- no empty page exists;
- no dead button exists;
- no unfinished module is public;
- first content package is reviewed;
- external pages are not shown as active before real setup;
- the public site remains stable.

## Step 7 — After activation

- Check desktop.
- Check mobile.
- Check links.
- Check preview image.
- Check first public page.
- Record the status.

## Time plan

- 0:00–0:30 review structure.
- 0:30–1:00 review first content package.
- 1:00–1:45 account and contact setup.
- 1:45–2:20 channel drafts and visual identity.
- 2:20–2:45 dashboard and mobile check.
- 2:45–3:00 final decision and controlled activation.
